quickRoute: Use four diagnostic probes to locate gaps. Read Quick recall, attempt each independent lesson checkpoint, and finish the mixed recall.
fullRoute: Follow rectangular arithmetic, conjugates and division, polar representation, and powers and roots. Predict in the plane activities and explain each result in your notes.

support.reason: Recover distribution, fractions, and equation manipulation.
Review radians, the unit circle, quadrants, and exact trigonometric values.
Reconnect coordinates, magnitude, and geometric representations.
Study the full algebra course and its complex-number lesson.
Prepare for complex representations used alongside later calculus.
Build toward engineering mathematics with complex exponentials.
Prepare the arithmetic needed for phasors and impedance.
Use complex exponentials in signal representations.
Support later circuit and device models.
Prepare for complex signal and frequency-domain calculations.

escalation.text: For first-time instruction, follow the MTH 215 complex-number lesson and linked free OpenStax sections. CEE 300, CEE 310, and CEE 324 supply later mathematical and physical models beyond this refresher.
